card.name: "Full" before prescribing information
card.fires_on: The word "full" right before "prescribing information" in cross-references such as "refer to the full prescribing information". It also fires weakly at a few spots right before "title" or a section number.

modes.label: Full prescribing information
modes.description: The word full (or Full) in a pointer sending the reader to another drug's complete label.
modes.example: Also refer to the amoxicillin and clarithromycin<< full>> prescribing information.

modes.label: Before a title or section
modes.description: Punctuation or the word section in a citation or URL just before a title or number.

card.writes: It pushes toward the word "title" and away from "revise" and "revision", so it expects a title-like word next.
card.plain: It marks the word "full" in phrases that send you to the full prescribing information.
